_note: Ukrainian, plain modern spelling (2019), for Ukrainian-speaking evangelical churches; docs/translating.md has the glossary shared with Russian. Buttons are infinitives, sentences to the person use the polite plural (Натисніть), sentence case, «…» and ʼ (U+02BC). The bar along the top: the views (mode tabs have a budget of nine letters), find, the Audience and Stage keys, the clock's neighbours.
